title: Load animation families as capability packs
summary: Split concrete animation assets into seven lazy capability packs, defer the full dashboard behind navigation, hydrate the selected player asynchronously with stale-view protection, preserve composite child clocks, and make runtime transfer the authoritative payload metric. Initial script transfer fell from 489079 to 278451 bytes with no regressions.
